name: Introduction and overview — Anzac-class Frigate — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Anzac-class Frigate
description: Introduction and overview of the Anzac-class Frigate: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Anzac class — ten built for Australia and New Zealand — are 3,600-ton multi-role frigates based on the German MEKO 200 design. Australian ships received major anti-ship-missile-defense upgrades. The class has deployed from the Gulf to the Pacific; Australia's Hunter class will replace it. Baseline facts: Australian/NZ frigate; 10 built; MEKO 200 based; major ASMD upgrades..
